blocks.x: I put it down already; I mentioned it on the cassette. This is in Korea?
This is Galbraith, Kenny Bryant, Willard Brown--I can't see the drummer, that's probably Ed Cornelius and is this Pruitt again?
I don't know; he was recommended to me, and I was so sorry. I had to send him back. Everybody had trouble with him. Benny Goodman had him too for a while
He wouldn't have lasted very long with Benny Goodman.
He didn't last long with Benny.
Where did you get Bernie Peacock from to begin with?
I don't remember where I got Bernie Peacock from, but I know I wish I didn't have him..
The funny thing about him was I remember meeting him at that time and he sent me a record, he moved back to Detroit, where his home is--I think his home is in Detroit--
This has got to be at the Homowack Lodge.
This is over at a hospital in Korea.
This is Huey Long, isn't it?
Yeah, Huey Long was on this trip. It's the same band. That's Jack McVae; he gave a party for me too when I came back from overseas. That's Marsha Mayor (phonetic spelling).
